author: gracecee
body:
OC and Lau. Best Vietnamese and seafood. Get the crab. The fruit drinks are great. There's a reason why whole families and young people go there. They have a second location but first is best. Get the shrimp skewers. The beef and noodles. If you're more adventurous the snails with tamarind sauce. If you go early enough when it first opens its great. The giant scallops are awesome. And it's affordable.

And Im saying this as someone whose eaten at Michelin stars in Rome, Italy, Mexico city new York Chicago Los Angeles. San Francisco. Japan. Bangkok. Not gourmand 2-3 stars. Maz in Tokyo was one of the most incentive but if you had to ask me where Id eat, OC and Lau. Hands down.
